exposure: Emergency obstetric and neonatal care (EmONC) services
outcome: Coverage, functionality and quality of EmONC services
Intrapartum and very early neonatal deaths
cohort: Pregnant women in the Kumba health district (KHD), the largest health district in Southwest Cameroon
finding: Major gaps were observed in the performance of signal functions as well as the quality and utilization of EmONC in the Kumba health district.
